text:
sara: FYI ops flagged a high error rate on embeddings in ap-southeast. We have a product webinar in 45m demonstrating embeddings-centered features. Do we push status page and put webinar on hold? @ben @nina

ben: yes push a short status and switch webinar landing to "holding; prerecord available". We'll need quick copy for registrants if we decide to pause.

nina: ops update: autoscaler flapped after a config push, we're rolling back config and restarting workers. ETA 30-60m. If it hits >30m we should default to prerecord to avoid ruins the demo.

ops-bot: incident created: INC-217555 (ap-southeast embeddings errors) 

craig: for inbound leads: tag demo/test-drive leads created now with "incident-apac" and route to APAC SDR queue. Also stop automated scheduling for hands-on sessions showing live embeddings.

hannah: marketing ops: pausing paid ads + sponsored posts. Also toggling CTA copy to "Watch prerecord or sign up for hands-on later".

sara: proposed status copy: "Investigating 1 Increased error rate affecting embeddings in APAC regions. Engineers are working on rollback and worker restarts. We will update within 20 minutes."

ben: add dedicated line: "Dedicated customers: minimal to no impact expected. Contact your CSM for concerns."

nina: ops note: once rollback finishes we'll run quick smoke tests; if green we'll allow webinar to proceed. Otherwise switch to prerecord.

sara: actions: ben publish status + translations; craig tag leads & update routing; hannah pause ads & change CTAs; nina keep ops updates to this thread. I'll check back at +20. Keep replies short.

ben: status published. french span and japanese translations pushed.

craig: routing updated; new demo leads flagged.

hannah: ads paused. updated landing copy.
